aside.registeredBody: Signed in, your saved details are waiting.

benefits.track: Steam sign-in links your account so we can deliver
benefits.addresses: Your purchases and their status in one place
benefits.saved: Mark lots to come back to

meta.title: Sign in
meta.description: Your Veltskins sign-in opens up orders, Steam delivery progress and the lots you have marked.

login.title: Sign in
login.checkoutHint: Checking out needs you signed in. Nothing in your cart moves.
login.invalid: That email and password don't match
login.failed: Signing you in failed. Please try again.
login.steamFailed: Steam sign-in didn't complete. Please try again.
login.steamNote: Your Steam ID is vouched for by Steam itself. Your Steam password stays invisible to us.

meta.title: Create an account
meta.description: Open a Veltskins account to buy Counter-Strike 2 skins and watch each one make its way to Steam.

register.title: Create an account
register.lead: Three short steps. These go on your invoice and establish that you are old enough to buy. Connecting Steam comes after that.
register.checkFields: Check {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}}
register.restricted: We don't open accounts or sell in {countries}.
register.terms: I have read and agree to the <link>Terms and Conditions</link>
register.privacy: We handle your details as described in our <link>Privacy policy</link>.
register.failed: The account could not be created. Please try again.
register.steamAlternative: Prefer not to use a password? <link>Sign in through Steam</link> instead.

meta.title: Reset your password
meta.description: Ask for a link that resets your Veltskins password.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Give us the email address on your account and a link for setting a new password will follow.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
forgot.sentHint: Nothing after a few minutes? Look in spam.
forgot.failed: The link did not send. Please try again.

meta.title: Set a new password
meta.description: Set the new password for your Veltskins account.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.invalidTitle: That reset link has run out, or has been used once already
reset.invalidBody: Ask for another and use it inside the window the email states.
reset.doneBody: The new password is in place. From here on, that is what signs you in.
reset.failed: Changing the password failed. Please try again.
